title: Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Hotel Marketing
description: The aim of this course is to provide comprehensive understanding of fundamental knowledge and skills in Hotel Marketing.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Hotel Marketing covers the importance of hotel marketing in business, market segmentation, product development, strategic pricing, product promotion, distribution channels, and online marketing. The course provides a comprehensive overview of the fundamental concepts and skills required for effective hotel marketing, enabling students to develop and implement successful marketing strategies.
